title: PRD v0 — ProDuh! Discovery
summary: Working PRD v0 capturing the initial problem statement, target user, MVP scope, KPIs, and evidence links gathered from email, chat, and the workshop.
problemStatements: Teams cannot connect strategy to daily work, so outputs don’t reflect goals.
High-level decks exist, but dev teams can’t see the ‘why’ in tickets; weekly updates are manual.
jobsToBeDone: Aggregate discovery inputs (emails, chats, meetings) into one place.
Generate crisp goals/KPIs from evidence without heavy process changes.
Show traceability between goals/KPIs and day-to-day work.
Produce a weekly narrative that explains progress and next steps.

title: Open Questions & Decisions Log — ProDuh!
summary: Single source for unresolved questions, recorded decisions, and assumptions for the ProDuh! MVP.

openQuestions.text: How opinionated should the app be about workflows (e.g., required goal linkage before starting work)?
openQuestions.proposedNextStep: Validate with two design partners during discovery interviews.

openQuestions.text: What is the minimum integration set that provides value without write permissions?
openQuestions.proposedNextStep: Pilot with Confluence/Jira read-only; measure narrative freshness and goal-linkage uplift.

openQuestions.text: How will teams provide KPI baselines when analytics are weak or siloed?
openQuestions.proposedNextStep: Ship CSV import + manual baselines; evaluate later swap to connectors.

decisions.text: Target user: PM/Tech Lead pair; Problem: ‘Strategy isn’t connected to daily work’.
decisions.rationale: Consistent stakeholder feedback and workshop alignment.

decisions.text: MVP scope: Evidence intake → Goals/KPIs draft → Traceability view → Weekly narrative.
decisions.rationale: Fastest path to demonstrate strategy→work linkage.
Minimize risk and setup complexity; still delivers value.

assumptions.text: Teams can manually provide KPI baselines if analytics is missing.
assumptions.riskIfWrong: Narratives feel subjective; mitigation: provide CSV template and examples.

assumptions.text: Read-only mode is enough to prove value in the first demo.
assumptions.riskIfWrong: Perceived as ‘viewer only’; mitigation: fast-follow write-back for goal-linking.
